message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the most common tools and platforms you can use to book flights—whether you’re searching online, using an app, or integrating flight data into your own software.

| Category | Tool / Service | What it offers |
|----------|----------------|----------------|
| **Web & Mobile Booking Sites** | **Google Flights** | Fast search, price alerts, flexible date view. |
| | **Skyscanner** | Multi‑airline comparison, “Everywhere” search, price alerts. |
| | **Kayak** | Aggregates many carriers, price predictions, bundle options. |
| | **Expedia** | Flights + hotels + car rentals, loyalty points. |
| | **Orbitz** | Similar to Expedia, often has exclusive deals. |
| | **Priceline** | “Name Your Own Price” and Express Deals. |
| | **Momondo** | Deep search across low‑cost carriers, price trend graphs. |
| | **Hopper** | Predictive pricing, mobile‑first UI, price alerts. |
| | **Trip.com** | Strong presence in Asia, multi‑currency support. |
| | **Travelocity** | Bundles, price match guarantee. |
| | **CheapOair** | Focus on low‑fare carriers, coupon codes. |
| | **Hotwire** | “Hot Rate” deals, instant booking. |
| | **Airbnb Experiences** (for flight‑related experiences) | Not a flight booking tool, but useful for travel planning. |
| **Airline Direct Websites** | **Delta, United, American, Southwest, JetBlue, Alaska, etc.** | Direct booking, frequent‑flyer benefits, seat selection. |
| **Mobile Apps** | **Google Flights App** | Same as web, push notifications. |
| | **Skyscanner App** | Price alerts, “Everywhere” search. |
| | **Hopper App** | Predictive alerts, mobile‑only deals. |
| | **Kayak App** | Price alerts, trip planner. |
| | **Airline Apps** | Seat maps, boarding passes, flight status. |
| **API & SDKs (for developers)** | **Amadeus for Developers** | Flight search, booking, price monitoring. |
| | **Skyscanner API** | Search, price alerts, flight availability. |
| | **Kiwi.com API** | Multi‑city itineraries, “Nomad” search. |
| | **Travelport API** | Global distribution system (GDS) access. |
| | **Sabre API** | GDS, inventory, booking. |
| | **FlightAware API** | Real‑time flight status, historical data. |
| | **OpenSky API** | Real‑time flight data, ADS‑B. |
| | **Google Flights API** (unofficial) | Limited public access, mostly for research. |
| **Travel Agencies & Aggregators** | **Travel agencies (online & brick‑and‑mortar)** | Personalized service, package deals. |
| | **OTA (Online Travel Agencies)** | Expedia, Booking.com, Priceline, etc. |
| | **Meta‑search engines** | Kayak, Skyscanner, Momondo. |
| **Price Alert & Prediction Tools** | **Hopper** | Predictive pricing. |
| | **Google Flights** | “Track Prices” feature. |
| | **Skyscanner** | “Price Alerts” for specific routes. |
| | **Kayak** | “Price Forecast” for future dates. |
| **Specialty & Niche Platforms** | **Airfarewatchdog** | Alerts for deep discounts. |
| | **Secret Flying** | Error fares, flash sales. |
| | **Scott’s Cheap Flights** | Email alerts for cheap fares. |
| | **FlightDeals** | Community‑shared deals. |
| | **Airfarewatchdog** | Alerts for specific routes. |
| | **FlightRadar24** | Real‑time flight tracking, useful for planning. |

### How to Choose

1. **If you want a quick, all‑in‑one search** – use Google Flights, Skyscanner, or Kayak.  
2. **If you’re looking for the lowest price** – try Hopper, Momondo, or Secret Flying.  
3. **If you’re a frequent flyer** – book directly with the airline to earn miles.  
4. **If you’re building a travel app** – integrate Amadeus, Skyscanner, or Kiwi.com APIs.  
5. **If you want real‑time flight status** – use FlightAware or FlightRadar24 APIs.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like deeper details on any particular platform or how to integrate a specific API!
